status_semantics.UNKNOWN: authorization, accountable roles or current evidence is missing; never show as passable
status_semantics.PREPARING: documents and physical alternative are being prepared; not open
status_semantics.VERIFIED_PASSAGE: authorized documents, physical installation, named competent human verification, expiry and fallback are complete
status_semantics.ACTIVE: temporary occupation is active and the passage remains within a valid human inspection window
status_semantics.DEGRADED: any critical evidence, route condition, barrier, notice, lighting, drainage, responsible role or inspection window has failed
status_semantics.AUTHORIZED_CLOSED: a competent authorized human has closed the passage and published an approved alternative
status_semantics.RESTORING: temporary occupation ended and the original function is being restored
status_semantics.RESTORED: the accountable party supplied current competent-human restoration evidence

automatic_transitions.trigger: critical evidence expires or is withdrawn
route obstruction or critical physical/operating check fails

ai_allowed: compare AI-assisted workflow with the non-AI baseline
ai_forbidden: declare a route safe, accessible or open
control traffic, signals, barriers or equipment
replace construction, supervision, inspection, maintenance or enforcement roles
restore status without competent current human evidence
